topography.title: Topography of the Lower Mekong Basin
topography.caption: Original Figure 1 on source PDF page 3. Lacombe et al. (2017); elevations derived from HydroSHEDS. Whole source page reproduced, with its original caption. This is a basin map, not a well-location dataset.

usgs-geology.title: Historical geology and geologic sections of Cambodia
usgs-geology.caption: Rasmussen & Bradford (1977), USGS Water-Supply Paper 1608-P, Plate 1. Historical map and administrative labels retained. Not a present-day aquifer-yield or drinking-water-safety map.

usgs-wells.title: Historical map of well locations in Cambodia
usgs-wells.caption: Rasmussen & Bradford (1977), Plate 2. Well locations and insets belong to the historical survey compilation; this plate does not describe the present operational well network.

usgs-sections.title: Historical lithologic sections of selected Cambodian areas
usgs-sections.caption: Rasmussen & Bradford (1977), Plate 3. Published cross-sections illustrate the arrangement of sediments and rock units along selected historical lines, not a uniform countrywide aquifer section.

recharge.title: Published regional recharge estimates
recharge.caption: Original Figure 4 on source PDF page 9. Lacombe et al. (2017). Circles show catchment estimates and grid cells show regional predictions. The 0.25° grid is a screening product; local clay cover can produce substantially different recharge. Whole source page reproduced.

recharge-ratio.title: Published recharge-to-rainfall ratio
recharge-ratio.caption: Original Figure 6 on source PDF page 11. Lacombe et al. (2017). The regional ratio is method-dependent; it is not a fraction of rainfall that may automatically be allocated to pumping. Whole source page reproduced.
